sentences.en: Sportswear is frequently worn as everyday wear by many college students.
sentences.zh: 许多大学生经常穿运动服作为日常穿着。

sentences.en: She loves to jog in her comfortable sportswear.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢穿着舒适的运动服慢跑。

sentences.en: The gym has a sale on sportswear this weekend.
sentences.zh: 健身房这个周末在卖运动服。
